Description

Take trillions of measurements to produce valuable information on RF spectrum and the networks that rely on it.

Creates maps, for example, that show the availability of radio frequency spectrum and wireless infrastructure, measuring 5G, LTE, internet-of-things, 3G, 2G, Wi-Fi and TV signals.
